AI PLATFORM
A complete system for leadership and team development.

Meet Arti, the intelligence behind Rising Team—combining personalized development, real-world team practice, and ongoing reinforcement together in one system designed to build manager judgment, not replace it.

PERSONALIZED PLANS
Continuously guide manager growth.

Managers build a path around their challenges, strengths, and business priorities—then Arti helps them schedule coaching and practice to build leadership “muscle.” 

AI COACHING
Support critical team moments.

Managers get 24/7 practical guidance for real leadership moments—like transformations and reorgs—grounded in your organization’s context.
‍

AI ROLEPLAY
Rehearse hard conversations.

Managers practice real scenarios with Arti, which knows their team members by name, style, and history—then get feedback to improve how they lead.
‍

TEAM-BUILDING SESSIONS
Build team skills and connection.

Managers run software-guided workshops with their teams—no facilitator required. These 10 to 90-min. sessions are evidence-based and help teams turn reflection into action.

How the system comes to life.

See how Arti brings personalized development, practice, and team experiences together for managers and teams.

See Arti in action

Customize Rising Team around your values, frameworks, and ways of working so development reinforces how leadership happens at your company.

Connected across your systems & timelines

Integrate with HCM, HRIS, and learning systems to reduce manual work and align with key timeline moments like performance reviews.

low lift for your team.

Enterprise teams are often asked to do more with less. Rising Team partners closely with your team to tailor the experience, support setup and launch, and help managers get value quickly—without creating extra burden on already stretched internal teams.

We help align the experience to your values, frameworks, and the kind of leadership you want to build.

Supported every step of the way

From setup through launch, our team works closely with yours to make rollout thoughtful, smooth, and manageable.

Designed to lighten the lift

Built to drive adoption
